paragraphs: Memorial Business Systems, or MBS, sells management software for cemeteries and funeral homes, delivered either from a cloud service or from an on-premises installation. Nexus is the office management system for cemeteries and funeral homes, and Nexus Web makes it available on the web, tablets, and phones. Add-ons include IMAP for cemetery mapping, DeedIt! for custom deeds, Blaze for cremains tracking, and MBS Report Writer for reports.

The company was formed by a cemeterian in 1983 to provide software for deathcare providers. Named clients quoted on the site include Catholic Cemeteries of Phoenix, the Diocese of Fresno, the Archdiocese of Seattle, and Sunset Memorial Park, Albuquerque, NM. MBS describes the suite as designed by members of the cemetery industry specifically for the industry.

quote.text: Nexus is the leading office management system for cemeteries and funeral homes.
